title: #283 Rural to Urban
prompt: Around the world, an increasing number of people are migrating from rural to urban areas. What is your opinion towards the phenomenon? Give examples to support your view.

promptSegments.text: Around the world, an increasing number of people are migrating from rural to urban areas.
What is your opinion towards the phenomenon?
Give examples to support your view.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first reason is that cities provide many opportunities for people to find work, allowing them to earn more money and live a better life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first reason is that cities provide many opportunities for people to find work, allowing them to earn more money and live a better life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, cities offer better services, such as good schools and hospitals, which help people stay healthier and strengthen the community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, cities offer better services, such as good schools and hospitals, which help people stay healthier and strengthen the community.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The movement of people from villages to cities is not always good for the people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The movement of people from villages to cities is not always good for the people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The focus on big towns is not the only way for people to find a job.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The focus on big towns is not the only way for people to find a job.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the economic benefits of migration, specifically better job opportunities and improved income.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the economic benefits of migration, specifically better job opportunities and improved income.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the infrastructural and service benefits of migration, highlighting better facilities like hospitals and schools in urban areas.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the infrastructural and service benefits of migration, highlighting better facilities like hospitals and schools in urban areas.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that the migration from rural to urban areas is not always beneficial, suggesting that local communities and rural areas should be supported instead.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that the migration from rural to urban areas is not always beneficial, suggesting that local communities and rural areas should be supported instead.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay highlights the negative impact of high population density on city infrastructure and the positive potential of local economies in rural areas.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay highlights the negative impact of high population density on city infrastructure and the positive potential of local economies in rural areas.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
